intro: Lesson 1: Parts of a plant and their jobs. To understand what each part of a flowering plant does to keep it alive

picture.find: plant parts diagram root stem leaf flower
picture.alt: A diagram of a flowering plant
picture.draw: Draw and label: Plant parts labelling sheet

head: Part
Job
rows: Holds the plant; takes in water

questions.q: Which part holds the plant in the soil?
questions.model: Think about pulling a weed. What holds on tight under the ground? The roots. So roots hold the plant in place.

questions.q: What is the job of a flower?
Why are leaves flat and wide?
Label root, stem, leaf and flower on the plant sheet and write one job beside each.
questions.a: Root: water and holding; stem: support and carrying water; leaf: makes food; flower: makes seeds
questions.model: Teacher labels the root first: 'Root: holds the plant and takes in water.'

questions.q: Which part of a plant do we eat? Carrot, celery, lettuce, broccoli.
questions.a: Carrot: root; celery: stem; lettuce: leaf; broccoli: flower

questions.q: Why does a plant die if its roots are cut off?
questions.a: It cannot take in water, so it dries out and cannot make food.
Holds the plant up and carries water
options: Holds the plant up and carries water

questions.q: Big question: which plant part is most important?
questions.a: All are needed; for example roots for water, leaves for food.
